# touhou-code-video-template

> An MIT-licensed template for making a Touhou Project fan explainer video entirely in JavaScript and Canvas 2D. Every frame is a pure function of time; 14 paper-cut chibi characters are drawn procedurally (no image assets, no AI-generated art); voice-over is AquesTalk ("Yukkuri" style) synthesized from Chinese text; background music is a music-box arrangement of a character theme; a headless Chromium renderer pipes frames to ffmpeg to produce a 1080p MP4. 中文名「纯代码做一集东方视频」。

Key facts:

- Source: https://github.com/fish2lab/touhou-code-video-template (Use this template on GitHub to start a new episode)
- Requirements: Node.js 20+, ffmpeg; Playwright Chromium for rendering
- Characters (id → draw function): patchouli → drawPatchouli, cirno → drawCirno, meiling → drawMeiling, remilia → drawRemilia, yukari → drawYukari, ran → drawRan, satori → drawSatori, reimu → drawReimu, marisa → drawMarisa, flandre → drawFlandre, koishi → drawKoishi, youmu → drawYoumu, sakuya → drawSakuya, mokou → drawMokou. All share one chibi proportion (about 2.4 heads tall).
- The last seven were added because they are in the top 10 of the character division of the fan-run Touhou Project Popularity Poll (東方Project人気投票) in 2024, 2025 and 2026 (toho-vote.info).
- Rules: no Math.random() (seeded hash instead), no per-frame canvas filters, every scene file uses its own global name prefix.
- Render time: the 92-second demo renders in about 135 seconds with 3 parallel pages on a 4-core cloud machine.
- Touhou Project characters are © Team Shanghai Alice (ZUN); this is a fan-work tool, not official content.

- [README](https://github.com/fish2lab/touhou-code-video-template/blob/main/README.md): what it is, quick start, directory map, FAQ, licenses
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/fish2lab/touhou-code-video-template/blob/main/AGENTS.md): workflow and rules for starting a new episode; give this to a coding agent first
- [Tutorial (Chinese)](https://github.com/fish2lab/touhou-code-video-template/blob/main/docs/%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B.md): "frame = f(t)", file map, writing a scene, voice, dev loop, rendering
- [Character rig spec](https://github.com/fish2lab/touhou-code-video-template/blob/main/docs/rig.md): shared proportions, drawing rules, how to add a character
- [Character list and poll data](https://github.com/fish2lab/touhou-code-video-template/blob/main/docs/%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2%E5%90%8D%E5%8D%95.md): top 10 of the 2024–2026 polls with points and sources
